column1: # Revizor campaign tables, i5-8300H, parsed 2026-11-11 from ~/rvzr_runs/campaign_*.log
# (one "=== FUZZ" block per row). All tab-separated.
#  test_cases    = rvzr "Test Cases:" in the end-of-run Statistics block. Counts every
#                  generated test case, filter-discarded ones included.
#  violations    = rvzr "Violations:".  wall_s = rvzr "Duration:" (fuzz loop only).
#  first_viol_id = 0-based Test Case ID of the first violation, from the progress counter.
#                  Cross-checked against report.txt "Test Case ID" in the violation dirs:
#                  199/199 runs agree on first ID and violation count. "-" = no violation.
#  clause_src    = where contract_execution_clause came from: cfg = the run's seeded yaml;
#                  viol = org-config.yaml of one of its violations; demo = class demo config,
#                  used when the /tmp yaml is gone and there was no violation to read it from.
#  - campaign_260910_2346.log has no FUZZ blocks (aborted start). campaign_260910_2347.log reran
#  - [ssbp-on control] rows in the two V4/SSB logs: seed not recoverable (/tmp/v4_configs gone).
#  - mc_260918 last row (V4 smt_off seed 1578476043): log ends mid-run, no Statistics.
#  - Violation count is time-bound: rvzr has no violation cap, but each confirmed violation
#    costs ~100-120 s of slow path (V1 seed 1170386145: detections at 81,199,327,413,516,624,
#    733,858,969 s). So 9 is the 900 s ceiling. The n=100 campaign (mc_260925) ran out of
#  - Per campaign, n=test-case budget, timeout=900 s, inputs=100.
## campaign_260907_1838.log   root==== V4/SSB campaign start: Mon Sep  7 06:38:24 PM BST 2026 ===
## campaign_260910_2347.log   root==== V4/SSB campaign start: Thu Sep 10 11:47:13 PM BST 2026 ===
# NO LOG: these scripts piped rvzr output through `| tail -30` to the terminal, so test cases
# executed and wall seconds were NOT recorded. Run budget was -n 200 -i 100 --nonstop
# --timeout 300. From report.txt in each violation dir: violations = number of dirs,
# first/last Test Case ID, and the last violation's "Time to detection" (a lower bound on wall).
# Seed/clause come from org-config.yaml. "none" = config set no program_generator_seed (random).
